popupExpandToggleTip: Enlarges the inner scrollable panels and the iframes up to their complete content instead of capturing them as they are seen. Frames from other sites ask for an additional permission one single time.
optionsLead: Changes are saved automatically and are synchronised with your browser profile.
optionsExpandPermGranted: Permission granted: frames from other sites are also expanded.
optionsExpandPermMissing: Without the "read all websites" permission, frames from other sites are captured as they are seen. Panels and iframes from the same site always work.
optionsRedactPIIDesc: Analyses the text the page exposes, looking for e-mail addresses, telephone numbers, card numbers, national identification numbers and API keys, and paints an opaque block over that which matches in the saved image. It cannot read text drawn as pixels: a canvas, an image, a PDF, a video frame. The detection runs on your device; nothing is ever sent anywhere. It applies to whole-page captures (document scrolling); the block is permanent, so review the result yourself.
scrollclipFormatHint: GIF plays everywhere. WebM is lighter and smoother (recorded live in your browser).
batchPermissionHint: Opening these pages requires a one-off permission the first time.
batchPermissionDeclined: The permission to open those pages has been denied.
